laws.rule: In the town of Mali Lošinj, the communal order decision bans gathering or lingering on public spaces in front of shops and cafés to drink alcoholic or soft drinks. Public events and cafés with an approved terrace are exempt. The decision names no fine for an individual for this rule.
laws.heading: Grad Mali Lošinj, Odluka o komunalnom redu (1 August 2019), article 42

sources.title: Odluka o komunalnom redu, Grad Mali Lošinj
sources.supports: article 42 drinking rule and exemptions (read directly)

local-law.note: Mali Lošinj only; Krk, Rab, Opatija and Rijeka not yet checked.
